page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8t-8x.32xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized, GPU-accelerated server instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The host environment provides 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 6462C processors and is backed by 1024 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU distribution ratio. Parallel computation is driven by eight NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture GPUs offering a combined total of 192 GB VRAM.

In terms of I/O throughput, the instance incorporates a 100 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile suitable for handling substantial data transfers between cluster nodes and remote repositories. There is no bundled local storage, meaning all persistent operating system files and dataset staging must rely entirely on remote network storage architectures. The aggregation of eight independent GPUs and significant host memory within a single node reduces inter-node networking overhead for distributed computing tasks, although reliance on external storage represents an architectural consideration for high-IOPS pipeline designs.

The instance profile is structured for compute-heavy parallel workloads that require massive graphics acceleration combined with sizable host memory capacity. Target deployments include distributed deep learning inference, high-concurrency visual rendering, video processing pipelines, machine vision tasks, and large-scale simulation workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8t-8x.32xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated server instance built for high-throughput parallel compute workloads. Driven by the KVM hypervisor, the platform provides 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 6462C processors operating at 3.3 GHz, paired with 1024 GB of system memory for an allocation of 8 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered through eight NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs supplying a combined 192 GB of VRAM. Networking capabilities feature a 100 Gbps baseline throughput to facilitate sustained data streaming across distributed environments. The instance includes no local storage, requiring remote network storage solutions for data persistence and operating system installations. Given its dense GPU configuration, high host memory capacity, and substantial network pipe, the ecs.gn8t-8x.32xlarge is suited for demanding workloads such as large-scale artificial intelligence model inference, batch video rendering, distributed machine learning pipelines, and intensive data processing tasks.
